summary: Backend smoke + integration tests for Jawel Swedish OCR app. 19/19 pytest tests passed against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Health, OCR scan (dualhead GPT-5.2 + Gemini 3.1 Pro), validation, rescan (attempts increments, confidence non-decreasing), email send via real commhub.cloud (delivered to Emil@jawel.se as TEST), Mongo persistence for both scans and email_log, and no _id leakage in responses are all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 350 lines – fine for now, but if AI prompts or commhub logic grows, split into ocr.py / email.py modules.
ocr_scan/ocr_rescan return generic 500 on Gemini exceptions caught later; would be cleaner to surface 502 for upstream LLM failures. Current behavior is acceptable.
Rescan endpoint accepts previous_text up to 6000 chars – good cap. Consider also clipping image_base64 size for safety.
Confidence calculation caps at 99% and bonuses up to +12 across attempts – reasonable.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is fine for this no-login internal tool; document if going public.
seed_data_creation: Synthesized a Swedish FAKTURA PNG document image (900x600) via Pillow with DejaVu Sans bold header + multiple body lines. Used as the OCR input. Test rows in mongo collections 'scans' and 'email_log' were created during the run and cleaned up by the tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests/. Reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (falls back to the known preview URL). Email test sends a REAL email to Emil@jawel.se with subject prefixed 'TEST: ' – do not over-run this test to avoid spamming. OCR tests take ~20s due to dualhead AI; allow ~3 min for full suite cold-start.
rca_of_issue: Initial run had 1 false-positive failure: my test used substring `'_id' not in response.text` which incorrectly matched 'message_id' from the commhub payload. Backend itself never leaks Mongo _id (excluded via .pop in scan and never returned in email response). Fixed assertion to recurse through parsed JSON keys instead. After fix: 19/19 pass.
verified_endpoints: POST /api/ocr/scan (valid PNG) -> 200, structured_text with **bold**, plain_text, confidence_percent in 0-100, error_estimate ~= 100-confidence, attempts=1, persisted in mongo.scans, no _id in response
POST /api/email/send (to=['Emil@jawel.se']) -> 200, ok:true, commhub returned status='queued' with message_id; email_log row persisted
